findings.title: Ransomware attack disrupts Queens Public Library services
findings.summary_md: NY1 reported that a ransomware attack disrupted computer systems and services at all 66 Queens Public Library branches. The library's website, public Wi-Fi, mobile app, on-site computers, and checkout and return machines were knocked offline while branches stayed open. No fines were charged for late returns during the outage.

findings.title: Queens Public Library says ransomware attack disrupted Wi-Fi, on-site computers
findings.summary_md: The Record reported that a ransomware gang encrypted QPL's systems and shut down many digital services across its 66 branches serving 2.3 million residents. The library issued multiple alerts on Wednesday, November 4, and confirmed that on-site computers, checkout and return machines, Wi-Fi, digital media services, and its mobile app were down. No ransomware gang had claimed the attack as of Thursday evening.
